simple.meaning: מַסְוֶה (maçveh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a veil.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַסְוֶה (H4533) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 34:33, with occurrences in Exodus.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַסְוֶה (H4533) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַסְוֶה (H4533) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַסְוֶה (maçveh) / H4533 is traced through Exodus 34:33, Exodus 34:34, Exodus 34:35 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.

timeline.evidenceText: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone; so Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
